title: Test Article - Verifying the Fixed Article Viewer
summary: A short test article created to verify the fixed view-article.html pipeline works end to end, from index lookup through to rendering.
body:
## This is a test

If you can read this paragraph rendered with proper formatting on the live site, the fix worked.

This confirms three things at once: the index lookup in view-article.html found this file correctly, the markdown body rendered properly through marked.js, and the whole chain from content/articles/ through articles_index.json to the viewer page is working.

**This file can be safely deleted** once you've confirmed it displays correctly.
